tool_args.rationale: All paid rows have H=0.8, leaving horizon-dependent stationary mechanisms observationally confounded. Fresh confirmation rejected both attempted branch models, so acquire an informative trajectory batch rather than overfit the existing single-horizon data or claim non-stationarity.

considered_alternatives.option: Author a revised stationary siphon/leak model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The linear-leak variant was refuted on fresh confirmation (RMSE 0.761175); the threshold-branch model also failed (RMSE 0.4128), so another fit from the same fixed-horizon rows is not justified.
Fresh confirmation refutes tested candidates, but does not establish non-stationarity or refute all stationary smooth mechanisms.
Already acquired; additional rows at another high-gradient regime are less informative than varied trajectories for distinguishing the remaining mechanism families.
